 Print Picture Credit: X The makers of Teja Sajja starrer ‘Hanu-Man’ directed by Prasanth Varma have announced their next project, titled ‘HanuMan 2: The Rise of Vanaras’. The upcoming fantasy adventure will feature Panja Vaisshnav Tej in the lead role and will be directed by Vi Anand . ‘HanuMan 2’ announced
 The production banner shared the announcement poster on its X account, which gives a look into the film's mystical world. It features a muscular man with dark curly hair, dressed in a rust-orange dhoti, rising above a sea of clouds. A massive tail curls around his body, while a giant, translucent figure of Lord Hanuman appears in the background. Golden light and a faint rainbow can also be seen. Watch Teja Sajja opens up about nerve-wracking stunt moments in 'HanuMan' shoot: 'I feared of dying' Sharing the announcement, the makers wrote, “What began with a dream continues with an even bigger vision. Proud to take the legacy of #HanuMan forward with our next ambitious venture. Presenting #HanuMan2 – THE RISE OF VANARAS. Looking forward to this exciting collaboration with #PanjaVaisshnavTej and the visionary @Dir_Vi_Anand as we set out to create something truly spectacular. More updates soon.” Join conversation

 Cast and release details of ‘HanuMan 2’
 The film also features Vinay Rai, Vennela Kishore and Samuthirakani. More details about the cast and story are expected to be announced later. It will be released in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada. Netizens ask about Teja Sajja and ‘ Jai Hanuman ’
 In addition to the announcement, it has prompted questions from fans about Teja Sajja's involvement in the new film. Some also wondered how the project connects with ‘Jai Hanuman’, the previously announced film featuring Rishab Shetty. One user questioned the makers in the comments section, writing, “Already Jai Hanuman is happening right with Rishabh Shetty..then why this one…” The makers have not yet clarified whether Teja Sajja will be part of ‘HanuMan 2: The Rise of Vanaras’ or how the new project relates to ‘Jai Hanuman’. Meanwhile, the 2024 film ‘Hanu-Man’ was directed by Prasanth Varma and starred Teja Sajja in the lead role. The film went on to mint a gross worldwide collection of over Rs 295 crore, as per Sacnilk.
